# 03 — Doors & Access

Everything people and vehicles pass through. Doors define rooms, so airtightness and animation timing are gameplay-critical (airlocks, quarantine, horde defense).

**15 parts · 20 Blender assets.** Standards for every card are in [00 — Blender Modeling Standards](00-blender-modeling-standards.md).
